data.name: Casa Pedro Loza
data.address: C. Pedro Loza 360, Centro Histórico, 44200 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a mansion dating from 1848 and retaining many period details, this upscale hotel is an 8-minute walk from both Catedral de Guadalajara and Museo Regional de Guadalajara.
Featuring ornate floor tiles and antique furniture, the 12 individually decorated rooms and suites come with free Wi-Fi, safes and flat-screen TVs. Some have balconies, and suites have living areas; an upgraded suite includes a whirlpool tub, a canopy bed and a private garden. Room service is available.
There's a patio restaurant serving Mexican and international fare, plus a bar in a former carriage house, and a terrace bar with rooftop views.
